definitions.t0: Frame timestamps are taken with time.perf_counter() at the instant OpenCV returns the frame — NOT true photon arrival. Sensor exposure and driver/USB transport add an unmeasured constant offset, so photon-to-answer latency reported here is a LOWER BOUND.
definitions.photon_to_first_token_ms: t(first generated token of the answer) - t0(frame that triggered the VLM call). Includes preprocessing, vision encoding, prefill and any IPC — never model-only time.
definitions.photon_to_answer_ms: t(final token of the answer) - t0(frame that triggered the VLM call). Same inclusions.
definitions.answer_staleness_ms: t(answer emitted) - t0(frame whose evidence backs that answer). For a cache hit this is the age of the cached scene evidence, not the age of the cache entry.
definitions.false_trigger_rate: Fraction of VLM invocations fired on frames externally labelled as carrying no semantic change. Requires ground-truth labels; null when the run has none.
definitions.accuracy_vs_oracle: Agreement with the per-frame oracle (VLM invoked on every frame) on the same query timeline. Null unless an oracle run was supplied.
definitions.percentiles: numpy.percentile with linear interpolation over the full population of the run (no warmup discarded unless the run config says so).
definitions.energy_j: Trapezoidal integration of NVML power samples over the measured window. 'marginal' subtracts the idle baseline measured before the workload started.
definitions.null_vs_zero: null means NOT MEASURED. 0 means measured and the value was zero. They are never interchangeable.

vram.note: NVML board-wide usage, includes other processes — not our allocation alone

key_quality.what_it_means: ROC AUC of embedding cosine similarity as a 'same scene state' classifier over RANDOM frame pairs. 0.5 means the key carries no scene-state information. But a good AUC here is not sufficient: what matters is the similarity available at the moments the cache is actually consulted — see similarity_at_trigger.

verdict.reason: at threshold 0.85 the cache avoids 52.5% of VLM calls with no loss of answer validity (1.000 vs 1.000 without).
verdict.root_cause: The cache is consulted ONLY when the scheduler decides to call, and the scheduler fires precisely when the frame is unlike recent scene state. At those moments the best similarity to anything already cached is 0.902 (median) — far below the 0.75–0.88 band where same-state and different-state pairs even begin to separate. The key itself is informative on random pairs (AUC 0.898); the problem is not the embedding. **The scheduler and the cache are competing for the same redundancy, and the scheduler already removed it.** After Phase 4 cuts calls to 0.42% of the per-frame oracle, the survivors are by construction the moments the scene genuinely changed — exactly the moments a cache cannot serve.

definitions.calls_avoided_pct: share of the policy's triggers served from cache instead of the VLM — the ONLY benefit
definitions.false_hit_rate: share of cache hits that served an answer from a DIFFERENT scene state — a confidently wrong answer at zero cost, which the system cannot detect
definitions.answer_validity: same primary metric as Phase 4, so the accuracy cost of caching is directly comparable
definitions.latency_benefit: A cache hit skips a VLM call whose measured cost is 159 ms p50 TTFT / 487 ms to a complete answer (Phase 3), and 43.8 J.
